data.title: 紫藤伊莉娜 · 晴空白浪中的暖橙比基尼跃动
data.description: 盛夏海滩浪花飞溅，伊莉娜身穿元气亮橙色系带比基尼在浅水中欢跳，双马尾飞扬，健康小麦色肌肤泛着晶莹水珠。
data.location: 热带碧海白沙滩浅水区
data.action: 涉水向前跃步，回身挥手呼唤，脸上洋溢着青梅竹马般毫无防备的元气笑颜
data.lighting: 明艳通透的夏日烈阳，浪花四溅折射彩虹般小光斑
data.camera: 动态抓拍平视机位，充满运动感与鲜活生机
data.promptProse: Irina Shidou splashes playfully through the turquoise surf on a sunny tropical shoreline. Sporting a vibrant tangerine-orange tie-side bikini that flatters her athletic physique, she turns mid-stride to wave enthusiastically toward the viewer. Droplets of sea spray glitter like diamonds in the dazzling midday sunshine around her bouncing brown twintails and infectious, sunny smile.
data.animaCaption: Irina bounds through the shallow ocean waves in her bright orange bikini, waving cheerfully with sparkling water drops flying.
